feeding_claim.verbatim: We firmly believe in raising animals on pasture, caring for the land, and selling meat locally.

pickup_locations: Downtown Columbus, third Saturday of the month (preorder only)
Madison Farmer's Market on Broadway Street
Seymour Farmer's Market and Winter Farmer's Market at the Jackson County Visitor Center

notes: Run by Liz and Nate on 100 acres 'in the trees and hollows of southern Indiana'. The site never names the town, so city is a placeholder: the lead said Camden, but Camden, Indiana is in the north and all pickups are in southeast Indiana (Seymour, Madison, Columbus); confirm the town before publishing. Meat CSA with six-month chicken, pork, egg and turkey shares and short lamb and turkey shares, picked up at markets; order form for market pickup; also sold at Bloomington Farm Stop Collective, Bethel Lane Farm Stop and local restaurants. 20 lb chicken bundle; no half or whole hog found.
